turns.text: That id does not exist. Listing what is actually there rather than guessing a neighbouring id.

There is no DOC-TAX-03. The corpus has one tax document, DOC-TAX-01, and I read it rather than guess at a near miss id.

It covers four things. The annual income tax return, due 30 June, which every registered business files even in a year with no income (DOC-TAX-01#S1). VAT registration, which is triggered by a turnover threshold rather than by sector (DOC-TAX-01#S2). Turnover tax, which is the monthly regime for businesses below that threshold and above the floor, due by the 20th (DOC-TAX-01#S3). And what happens when you file late (DOC-TAX-01#S4).

What it does not cover: customs and import duty, excise, anything on international transactions, and anything about appeals or disputes. If your question was about duty at the port, that is outside this corpus and I would be making it up.

The corpus is synthetic, written for a software demonstration, so it is not legal advice.
